summary: The author compares four AI models, including Claude Opus 5.5, on building an animated 3D whale breaching scene over water.

post.originalText:
4 Argon vs Opus 5.5 vs GPT 6 Astra vs Kimi K3

I asked all four to build a 3D whale breaching scene.

Argon's level of detail is on another level, and it wins on photorealism. Opus and Kimi look more realistic than Astra.

But what a comeback from Google!! 🔥 https://t.co/adz2OExpg1

sourceMaterials.text: @jamesdtoole Yes, no doubt about that, but Argon is Google's greatest comeback yet.
